panel.selection_rule: Fixed before any panel-level outer outcome; retain heterogeneous positive, mixed, and negative/control structural cases. Do not rank, discard, or replace symbols using panel outcomes.

causal_methodology.gap_definition: Consecutive observed bars separated by at least 30 minutes; no synthetic bars or forward fill.
causal_methodology.admission: Use only rows observed before the signal; admit a shock only when the prior scale is available and finite.
causal_methodology.entry: Next observed M5 open at or after signal time plus one M5 decision delay.
causal_methodology.exit: First observed open at or after the scheduled measurement target.
causal_methodology.overlap: At most one active measurement per symbol; no synthetic fill and no same-symbol overlap.
causal_methodology.right_censoring: Pending or active observations without a valid exit remain reported as censored and are excluded from settled response summaries.

primary_outputs: settled directional response distribution by symbol
response persistence by symbol and asset class
analysis_discipline.aggregation: Report per-symbol distributions first; report the panel aggregate only as descriptive, sample-weighted structural information.
analysis_discipline.multiple_testing: Treat all six symbols and all exploratory summaries as descriptive structural tests; do not select an economic identity or claim significance from unadjusted outcomes. Any later confirmatory claim requires a separately frozen correction and prospective outer evaluation.
analysis_discipline.tie_break: If a descriptive ordering is required, sort by settled sample count, active-week coverage, then median directional response; ties resolve by broker symbol lexicographic order. This ordering cannot alter panel membership.

confirmatory_outer_testing.primary_endpoint: Per-symbol sign of causal directional_60m_return after the frozen session-gap shock admission rule
confirmatory_outer_testing.per_symbol_test: ONE_SIDED_EXACT_BINOMIAL_SIGN_TEST; exact zero returns excluded prospectively
confirmatory_outer_testing.secondary_magnitude_outputs: Median/mean directional return and event-density diagnostics remain descriptive unless separately frozen.

cost_authority_before_outer.rule: Before any cost-aware or economic conclusion, bind candidate-independent broker-realistic friction authority for all six symbols prospectively. Wave01 structural returns may not tune the cost model.

independent_outer_contract.rationale: The six-symbol panel and methodology were selected after observing Wave01 structural summaries. Wave01 bytes remain DEVELOPMENT and cannot serve as an independent outer evaluation.
